activity_id.description: Required activity ID; membership and selected athlete ownership are checked before changing a comment.

athlete_id.description: Target athlete; defaults to selected athlete in coach mode, or the only athlete otherwise. Format: i12345 or 12345.

include_full.description: Include the original upstream comment under before.full for recovery; default returns prior text and identifiers only.

message_id.description: Existing comment ID from get_activity_messages. The credential owner must be the comment author; chat IDs are resolved by the server.
